query_analysis.original_query: Our liquid-liquid extractor shows oscillations in flow rates between stages. Could this be related to pump controls or system instability?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate the root cause of flow rate oscillations in a liquid-liquid extractor, focusing on potential issues with pump controls and system stability.
